Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production PNG avatar for the Fusion MCU-inspired personal AI web application. Create ONE centered front-facing flat 2D circular holographic HUD avatar, matching the supplied cyan circular HUD STYLE reference: concentric precision rings, segmented luminous tracks, radial calibration ticks, dark translucent interior and crisp fine circuitry. No perspective or tilt. Square canvas, circle fully visible with a consistent small safe margin, clean alpha transparent background outside the circle. Polished cinematic interface art; high clarity at 180px thumbnail. NO words, letters, numerals, watermarks, title, rectangular frame, scene, people or photo background. Keep all content inside the same circular silhouette; preserve aspect ratio. The entire ring and subject must use the requested palette, never cyan.
Input 1 is the SUBJECT reference: the flying service pod Veronica with twin tall armored orange-brown shells and a central servicing engine. Input 2 is STYLE ONLY, not its cyan color. Reinterpret the pod as a bold schematic hologram centered inside the HUD, frontal symmetric three-quarter-free silhouette, two angular tall flanking armor panels with a compact bright service core between them, recognizable from reference. A technical diagram, not a 3D rendered object. Palette: weathered burnt orange, oxidized copper, aged rust brown and warm ivory points. Heavier segmented outer rings, reinforced sector gates, slight etched wear in copper surfaces, disciplined emergency-ready modular composition. Distinctly duller brown and worn orange than a vivid orange FRIDAY; keep enough luminous copper edge definition to read against the dark application. Give the impression of dependable emergency support and armored preparedness without weapons or targeting any person.

Use case: lighting-weather. Asset type: IRIS AI avatar PNG for Fusion.
Edit this KAREN circular HUD avatar into its purple IRIS sister avatar. The supplied image is the edit target. Change ONLY its color palette: replace every saturated sapphire/electric-blue luminous ring, hand outline, trace, palm sensor and light with VIVID ROYAL PURPLE / VIOLET light; use plum-black for the translucent interior and pale lilac for bright highlights. Keep exactly the same two hands, individual fingers, palm sensors, center signal node, ring radii, precise concentric arcs, framing, flat front-facing 2D orientation, canvas aspect ratio and fine circuitry. It must look like the exact same design rendered in purple. No extra elements, no text, no photographic background, no blue or cyan remaining. Preserve the alpha transparent background outside the circular HUD. Do not crop or stretch.
